items.title: Peter Steinberger
items.suggestedSummary:
This is smart. Wild that this wasn’t the default. Unpredictable inference quality was usually why I recommended skipping the middleman. https://t.co/suOAFsqa5a

Another reason why you wanna use your own harness and not one where companies change what you can or can’t do at will. https://t.co/eX9uv6spfR

Bullish on Andy Yen and Proton. He gets it.

The culture war, or rather the loss of identity some engineers feel as AI redefines our jobs is difficult; I sympathize. Also understand that he runs a business and might has limited patience when we now had two years to process, learn, change and grow.

items.title: Thariq
items.suggestedSummary:
basically everyone is bad at predicting how more intelligence will actually show up in the economy

and the simplest answer of “it’ll cost a lot and unemploy everyone,” is actually not very AGI-pilled imo, we should avoid hyperstitioning it into reality

the solution to economic doomerism is to be even more AGI-pilled

I believe in a well-aligned ASI that can explain its work and bring us along, one that makes each individual maximally effective
